# Alert storm from a single failing node flooding on-call

On-call is paged dozens of times in minutes for what appears to be one underlying problem.

A single node going down triggered every dependent service's individual alert with no inhibition/grouping rules, burying the real signal in noise.

1. Confirm all alerts trace back to one node-down event
2. Add an Alertmanager inhibition rule so HostDown suppresses dependent TargetDown alerts
3. Group alerts by node and add a repeat-interval
4. Test by simulating a node failure in staging

Error Details
```
PagerDuty: 143 alerts in 4 minutes; Alertmanager: no inhibition rule matched; 'HostDown' fired alongside 40 dependent 'TargetDown' alerts
```

Tags: monitoring, alert-storm, inhibition, alert-fatigue, alertmanager
